hits.title: Sprout Social cuts 20% of workforce in restructuring plan By Investing.com
hits.snippet: Investing.com -- Sprout Social began notifying employees on Tuesday about a workforce reduction that will eliminate approximately 260 positions, or 20% of its staff. The company’s board approved the restructuring plan on July 8, 2026. Sprout Social estimates it will incur pre-tax restructuring charges between $18.0 million and $20.0 million related to the workforce reduction. The charges will consist primarily of cash expenditures for employee severance payments and benefits. The company expects to recognize substantially all of these charges in the third quarter of 2026.
